children: Previously at Legrand India, Jalani served as Group Manager - Trade & Experiential Marketing
Shashank Jalani has joined Tata Power Renewable Energy as Group Head - Brand Marketing (Rooftop Solar).
Jalani confirmed the development through a LinkedIn post, marking a move to the renewable energy sector after more than five years with Legrand India.

“Excited to begin a new chapter as Group Head - Brand Marketing (Rooftop Solar) at Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited. After a rewarding journey at Legrand, spanning brand, communications, retail and experiential marketing, I’m excited to take on this new challenge and build the next phase of my journey with Tata Power”, he stated in his LinkedIn post.

At Legrand India, Jalani last served as Group Manager - Trade & Experiential Marketing. During his tenure of over five years, he worked across brand, communications, retail and experiential marketing.
